summary: Read and manage a My Hot Lunchbox school-lunch account from a shell with curl — sign in, list students, read the lunch calendar and cart, check orders, deliveries and payments. Use when you want My Hot Lunchbox data without running the MCP server, in a script, or on a machine where the MCP is not installed.
